summary: Comprehensive testing of Content Studio (Agent 9). All 9 backend endpoints pass and all 5 UI views (Dashboard, Create, Library, Calendar, Settings) render correctly. Full AI generation pipeline (Research → Draft → Review) verified end-to-end via both pytest and Playwright — produced a 9/10 quality post in ~20s. LinkedIn OAuth for Vineet correctly reports connected=false (expected, per prompt).
passed_tests: POST /api/content-studio/generate → post_id + generating; status polled → status=draft, quality_score present, content persisted, list retrieval confirmed; delete cleanup ok
POST /api/content-studio/calendar/generate (7 days) → success with parsed calendar items
UI: LandingPage shows Content Studio card and routes to /content-studio
UI: Agent login with Agent@2024! succeeds
UI: Dashboard renders stats grid + 18 pillar chips + recent content
UI: Create view has select-pillar, select-content-type, topic-hint, generate-btn
UI: Clicking Generate shows generation-pipeline; preview-content appears with title, pillar/type badges, quality score, and full content
UI: Calendar shows 7 day cards + gen-calendar-btn
UI: Settings view renders (LinkedIn not connected)
critical_code_review_comments: content_studio.py uses bare `except:` in 3 places (research/review JSON parse, calendar parse) — should catch json.JSONDecodeError explicitly.
CS_LINKEDIN_REDIRECT_URI computation on line 28 is fragile — expression mixes ternary with string concat; consider clearer construction.
oauth_status returns None for connected_at when field is not a datetime; also .isoformat() call would crash if string — currently guarded by isinstance, acceptable.
Infographic route hard-codes model 'gemini-3.1-flash-image-preview' — verify supported by emergentintegrations at runtime.
cs_oauth_states is in-memory dict — states lost on restart (minor for OAuth window).
Publish flow was not exercised because Vineet LinkedIn OAuth not connected (per prompt, expected).
seed_data_creation: Test-generated posts were deleted after pipeline test. Calendar test upserted 7 items (dates match existing seed rows).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Content Studio is fully functional. AI pipeline takes ~15-25s (3 GPT-4o calls). LinkedIn publish flow (POST /publish/{post_id}) not tested end-to-end because Vineet OAuth not connected — will fail with 400 until user completes /oauth/connect flow. Infographic generation (POST /posts/{post_id}/infographic) not tested (uses Nano Banana / gemini image model).
